business_problem: Before the strategic partnership between UJJI AI and Google Cloud, the development of a single corporate training, especially for banks and financial entities, struggled with slow and linear production cycles, requiring a few weeks on average.
solution_summary: Google's cloud-based AI infrastructure replaced our reliance on complex legacy systems. With Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, we created a smarter layer capable of building extremely robust and disruptive training materials in just a few minutes. Adopting Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform allowed UJJI AI to shift the paradigm around customer productivity. Responsiveness in the creation of legal and administrative materials was significantly improved: repetitive, slow tasks, such as preparing trial summaries and meeting minutes, which used to take 40 minutes, now take less than a minute with the help of Gemini. UJJI AI innovated material development for diverse industries, particularly finance. Leveraging Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform's serverless infrastructure and Gemini models, they cut production costs by 85% and accelerated content development up to 300x.
